Name: Hashabiah, Officer of Hebron
Summary: Of the Hebronites, with his brethren men of valour, officers over Israel west of Jordan.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:30: Of the Hebronites, with his brethren men of valour, officers over Israel west of Jordan.
LifeLesson: The mention of Hashabiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
